cover_letter:
Dear Pulse Foundation Team,

I am writing to express my profound interest in the Communication & Events Intern position, drawn to your innovative spirit and commitment to using AI to amplify impactful communication. My background as a junior digital marketer, combined with practical experience in content creation, social media management, and a keen interest in AI-driven tools, makes me a strong candidate eager to contribute to your purpose-driven environment.

At Episto, I have gained valuable experience in managing on-page SEO, writing keyword-targeted blog content, and maintaining client websites using WordPress. This involved not only publishing content but also ensuring its organic visibility. My personal project, mirook.com, further showcases my capabilities in digital communication, where I designed a multi-page WordPress site, implemented social media integration for Instagram and Facebook, and actively managed its online presence. This experience has equipped me with a solid foundation in digital content publishing and community engagement, which I believe is a core focus of this internship.

What particularly excites me about this role is Pulse Foundation’s forward-thinking approach to AI and automation. I am comfortable with AI-assisted content tools and have proactively applied Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) techniques, including structured data and llms.txt files, to enhance visibility across AI-powered search engines for mirook.com. This hands-on experience, coupled with proficiency in tools like Canva and WordPress, aligns well with your team’s focus on smart workflows and co-creating visual content. I am keen to further refine AI-assisted workflows and bring my own habits to your team.

I am a proactive team player, fluent in English and Turkish with B1 Dutch, and eager to learn the intricacies of event coordination and content storytelling that brings a mission to life. I am confident that my blend of technical marketing skills, enthusiasm for AI, and collaborative mindset will allow me to thrive in this fast-moving, impactful internship.

Thank you for considering my application. I am enthusiastic about the opportunity to contribute to Pulse Foundation and would welcome an interview to discuss how my skills can benefit your team.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
